[[Tatsuki Kobe]] ([[Pokémon Journeys: The Series|JN]])| }} '''Saturn's Toxicroak''' (Japanese: '''サターンのドクロッグ''' ''Saturn's Dokurog'') is [[Saturn]]'s main battling Pokémon in the {{pkmn|games}}, {{pkmn|animation}}, and {{pkmn|manga}}. ==In animation== ====''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]''==== [[File:Saturn and Toxicroak.png|thumb|left|250px|Toxicroak and Saturn]] Toxicroak was the second Pokémon that [[Saturn]] was revealed to have, and has been used in all of Saturn's appearances since its debut in ''[[DP069|Enter Galactic!]]'', except ''[[DP111|Saving the World From Ruins!]]''. In its debut episode, Toxicroak was sent out to send Team Rocket blasting off. Later, it appeared to battle against {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, but ended up battling {{an|Brock}} and his {{TP|Brock|Croagunk}} before [[Team Galactic]] escaped. It was shown to be very powerful in combat. After this incident, it developed a rivalry with Brock's Croagunk. [[File:Brock Croagunk Saturn Toxicroak.png|thumb|220px|Toxicroak's rivalry with Brock's Croagunk]] In ''[[DP096|Losing Its Lustrous!]]'', Toxicroak helped Saturn steal the [[Adamant Orb]] from a high security plane and also defeated Brock's Croagunk later in a showdown. In ''[[DP097|Double Team Turnover!]]'', Toxicroak was used alongside [[Mars]]'s {{p|Purugly}} and several {{p|Golbat}} belonging to the {{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}}s. It managed to knock out [[Ash's Chimchar]] after Chimchar defended [[Ash's Pikachu]] from a {{m|Poison Jab}} while performing a direct {{m|Volt Tackle}}. In ''[[DP136|Gateway to Ruin!]]'', Toxicroak used {{m|Rock Smash}} to destroy a wall on [[Mt. Coronet]] to uncover some old ruins. It then sent Team Rocket blasting off. It also appeared in ''[[DP151|The Needs of the Three!]]'' and ''[[DP152|The Battle Finale of Legend!]]'', where it successfully battled [[Gary's Electivire]] and {{TP|Gary|Umbreon}}. During the final battle with Team Galactic, it was sent out to repel Ash's Pikachu and the other Pokémon. However, Croagunk leapt from {{AP|Gliscor}} just as Toxicroak emerged, striking it in the head with {{m|Brick Break}} and knocking it out in one blow, leaving Croagunk satisfied and ending their rivalry. At the conclusion of the villainous team's plans, Team Galactic was arrested. ====''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''==== Toxicroak appeared in ''[[JNS01|The Arceus Chronicles (Part 1)]]'', helping Saturn capture a {{p|Heatran}}. It reappeared in ''[[JNS02|The Arceus Chronicles (Part 2)]]'', where it had a rematch against Brock's Croagunk. The battle continued in the [[JNS03|next episode]], with both sides unable to gain an advantage over the other until {{an|Cynthia}} arrived. Toxicroak, alongside the rest of [[Team Galactic]], eventually fled, though they were later captured and tied up by her {{p|Roserade}}'s {{m|Power Whip}}. ===Personality and characteristics=== As a member of Team Galactic, Toxicroak is evil and very hostile, just like its Trainer. It would often get into fights with [[Brock's Croagunk]] and would usually come out the victor, with Croagunk getting injured during the battle. ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|poison|fighting|Saturn Toxicroak {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Poison Jab|1=Sludge Bomb|2=Rock Smash}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Poison Jab|1=Sludge Bomb|2=Rock Smash}}|image2=Saturn Toxicroak {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Dark Pulse|1=X-Scissor|2=Dig}}.png|caption2=Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Dark Pulse|1=X-Scissor|2=Dig}}}} {{anmov|dark|Dark Pulse|DP069|Enter Galactic!}} {{anmov|poison|Sludge Bomb|DP069|Enter Galactic!|rec=yes}} {{anmov|poison|Poison Jab|DP096|Losing Its Lustrous!}} {{anmov|fighting|Rock Smash|DP136|Gateway to Ruin!}} {{anmov|bug|X-Scissor|DP151|The Needs of the Three!}} {{anmov|ground|Dig|JNS01|The Arceus Chronicles (Part 1)|rec=yes}} {{anmov/f|fighting}} ==In the games== ===In the [[core series]]=== Toxicroak has appeared alongside Saturn as his main battling Pokémon in every game he has appeared. {| ! colspan="2" | {{game2|Diamond|Pearl|Platinum}} |- ! She first appeared as a {{p|Croagunk}} in ''[[PS349|Passing by Probopass and Maneuvering around Magnezone]]'' with her Trainer. In ''[[PS352|Crowded by Croagunk & Advanced on by Abra I]]'', she was used to battle [[Paka and Uji]] with Saturn's {{p|Abra}}. With her ability to detect her opponents' movements, she had an advantage. Despite this, she was eventually defeated along with Abra. In ''[[PS410|Creeping Away from Cradily]]'', at the Spear Pillar, she was used to battle [[Roark]] and [[Fantina]] along with Abra and {{p|Octillery}}. Eventually, she was defeated along with the rest of Saturn's team. ===={{MangaArc|Platinum}}==== In the {{MangaArc|Platinum}}, she was revealed to have evolved into a {{p|Toxicroak}}. In ''[[PS436|The Final Dimensional Duel VI]]'', she was used by Saturn at the [[Distortion World]], where she did battle with [[Mira]]'s {{p|Alakazam}}. Mira attempted to make the fight last long, but they were interrupted by {{p|Giratina}} when it flew past them. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|poison|fighting|Saturn {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Toxicroak Poison Jab|1=Croagunk Sucker Punch|2=Croagunk Poison Jab}} Adventures.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Poison Jab|1=Sucker Punch as a Croagunk|2=Poison Jab as a Croagunk}}}} {{anmov|poison|Poison Jab|PS352|Crowded by Croagunk & Advanced on by Abra I}} {{anmov|dark|Sucker Punch|PS353|Crowded by Croagunk & Advanced on by Abra II}} {{anmov/f|fighting}} ===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!=== [[File:Saturn Toxicroak DPA.png|thumb|200px|Toxicroak in Diamond and Pearl Adventure]] Toxicroak first appears while Hareta is in a cave and traps him with a {{m|Sludge Bomb}}. Later, while Hareta was battling Saturn, he was hurt by Toxicroak's attack causing him to be a bit weak. However, {{p|Azelf}}'s willpower caused Hareta to get back up and activated Toxicroak's {{a|Anticipation}}. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|poison|fighting|Saturn Toxicroak {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Sludge Bomb|1=Poison Jab}} DPA.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Sludge Bomb|1=Poison Jab}}}} {{anmov|poison|Sludge Bomb|DPA11|The Legendary Pokémon, Captured}} {{anmov|poison|Poison Jab|DPA11|The Legendary Pokémon, Captured}} {{anmov/f|fighting}} ==In the TCG== Saturn's Toxicroak is featured in the TCG as a [[Pokémon SP (TCG)|Pokémon]] {{SP|G}}.
